```yaml
name: CI Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "agents-docs/**"
      - "packages/agents-core/src/**"
      - "agents-cli/src/**"
      - "agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "agents-docs/**"
      - "packages/agents-core/src/**"
      - "agents-cli/src/**"
      - "agents-api/__snapshots__/openapi.json"
  schedule:
    # Mondays at 6am UTC
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build, lint, and typecheck agents-docs
        run: |
          export NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192"
          pnpm turbo run build lint typecheck --filter=@inkeep/agents-docs
```
